args.message:
I added up order amounts for each city (identified by region and city name together), then took the plain average of those city totals within each region, so every city counts equally.

| Region | Cities | Total revenue | Average city revenue |
|---|---|---|---|
| North | 3 | 109,334.76 | 36,444.92 |
| South | 3 | 104,269.90 | 34,756.63 |
| East | 2 | 68,738.70 | 34,369.35 |
| West | 2 | 49,151.79 | 24,575.90 |
| No known region (null) | see below | 1,193.30 | 596.65 |

The unknown-region group's 596.65 is its total split across two groups: one known city, plus orders with no city at all, which I counted as a single city group. Those orders most likely belong to customer IDs missing from the customer table, but I didn't check that directly. If those orders should be left out instead, the figure for this group would change.
